info.description: inclusionAI mixture-of-experts speech-synthesis model. The Ling V3 backbone has 7.9B total parameters and about 1.3B active per token. It takes text and an optional reference clip and writes audio, including multi-speaker dialogue. The card lists the MIT license. No context limit, release date, or first-party hosted price is published.

zh.description: inclusionAI 的混合专家语音合成模型。Ling V3 骨干总参数 7.9B，每 token 大约激活 1.3B。输入为文本和可选的参考音频，输出音频，并支持多说话人对话。模型卡写明许可证为 MIT。未公布上下文上限、发布日期或第一方托管价格。
